## Course data (loads automatically; click to see the code)

R runs inside your browser. The first visit downloads R and the packages, which takes 20–40 seconds; after that the browser caches them. Wait for this block to finish before running exercises.

```{webr}
#| autorun: true
#| edit: false
#| output: false
# dplyr/tidyr go last so that select() and filter() are never masked by MASS or stats
pkgs <- c("ggplot2", "broom", "car", "emmeans", "lme4", "lmerTest", "sandwich", "lmtest",
          "pROC", "performance", "palmerpenguins", "ISLR2", "tidyr", "dplyr")
for (p in intersect(pkgs, rownames(installed.packages())))
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(p, character.only = TRUE))

# Western blot densitometry: 4 genotypes x 4 biological reps x 3 technical reps
blot <- read.csv("data/western_blot_example.csv")
blot$Ratio    <- blot$Target_Intensity / blot$Loading_Control_Intensity
blot$Genotype <- factor(blot$Genotype, levels = c("WT", "HET", "KO", "RESCUE"))

# One row per biological replicate (technical replicates averaged)
blot_bio <- aggregate(Ratio ~ Genotype + Bio_Rep, data = blot, FUN = mean)

quine <- MASS::quine
if (requireNamespace("palmerpenguins", quietly = TRUE)) penguins <- palmerpenguins::penguins
if (requireNamespace("ISLR2", quietly = TRUE)) Default <- ISLR2::Default
if ("ggplot2" %in% loadedNamespaces()) theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 13))
```
:::
